title: How to Spot Fake Avocado Whitening Creams and Choose Safely
ex: Big promises, no ingredient list and no batch number are warning signs. Learn the red flags of unsafe avocado creams and what a proper label should show.
rt: How to Spot Fake Avocado Creams Safely | Mirc Glow
rd: Fake avocado cream red flags and avocado whitening cream side effects: hidden steroids or mercury, what a proper Indian label shows, and how to choose safely.
quick: Unsafe avocado creams often promise a big change in a few days, skip the full ingredient list, and have no batch number or manufacturer details. Some unregulated creams have hidden steroids or mercury. Buy sealed, fully labelled packs, patch test, and see a dermatologist if a cream causes problems.
facts: Skin renews roughly every 4–6 weeks, so a big change in days is a warning sign.
A proper label shows ingredients, manufacturer, licence, batch number and dates.
Some unregulated creams have been found to contain steroids or mercury.
No cosmetic cream can change your natural skin colour.
